_comment: Airport-center frame ablation, docs/2026-09-03_airport_frame_ablation_plan.md. One fixed recipe (TSConfig state-v1 defaults, iTransformer, full horizon, all aircraft) across every arm; NO per-arm cross-validation, because selecting hyperparameters separately per arm would confound the frame with the search. Arm A anchors the chart at the assigned threshold (the target is the origin); arm B anchors it at the airport reference point (the target is a point the model is never told); arm C is B plus the target's chart position and runway course fed as input-only constant channels. The fourth arm is the free control from plan Phase 3.4: A plus the conditioning mechanism, under which the extra channels are one constant row per run — if it moves any metric the plumbing is wrong, not the science. Same manifest, same eligibility roster, same split seed: the arms are paired flight-by-flight on the validation split; outer-test stays sealed.

arms.label: arm B: airport-anchored ENU, target never given
arm C: airport-anchored ENU + target conditioning channels
control: threshold ENU + conditioning (expected = arm A)
